component.name: Bazecor
component.summary: Configurator for Dygma Raise and Defy keyboards

description.p: **This is a community package of Bazecor and not officially supported by Dygma Lab S.L.**
Bazecor is the graphical configurator for the Dygma Raise and Defy keyboards. While still heavily under development, it's at a stage where it is already usable.

The primary purpose of the application is to allow one to configure their keyboard without having to compile or flash firmware, by storing the configuration on the keyboard itself, in EEPROM. There are no external tools required, just Bazecor itself.

ul.li: Layout Editor: Edit keymaps on-the-fly, copy layers, and set defaults.
Macro Editor: Create, manage, and backup macros.
Colormap Editor: Customize per-key and underglow LED lighting.
Firmware Upgrade: Update keyboard firmware directly from the app.

description.p: CRITICAL: Bazecor requires read/write access to USB devices. You must install udev rules on your host system for the keyboard to function correctly.
While we work on new firmware updates, we thought we'#39;/gd give Bazecor some well-deserved love.
For this release, we'#39;/gve focused on improving the Preferences section, which is now renamed "quot;/gSettings"quot;/g to better align with the names used by most operating systems and apps.

ul.li: We moved the option to change the default layer to Typing &/g Keys, which we'#39;/gve renamed to Keys and Layers.
Removed redundant text in the Keys and Layers configuration options.
We removed the Advanced submenu item, as it only contained the option to change the default layer.
We added the option to restore the default backup for your keyboard in the Backups section.
We fixed a bug where "quot;/gHighlight Layer change"quot;/g was reset when updating the firmware.
We improved the virtual keyboards, as they didn'#39;/gt match the current default backups.
We added a filter so you can'#39;/gt accidentally restore a Raise 2 backup into a Defy, and vice versa. You can still restore backups between the OG Raise and the Raise 2.
We removed the Neuron manager, as the information provided was confusing to most users.
There are also bigger under-the-hood improvements on how Bazecor handles different keyboards to prepare it for future developments.

description.p: We hope you like this update!
